what: You read a text and answer a question by choosing more than one correct option.
tests: Reading: understanding details, main ideas and the writer's purpose.

scoring.note: Pearson's page names no separate traits for this task.

strategy: Read the question first so you know what to look for.
Check each option against the text. Choose only options the text clearly supports.
Do not guess. In our practice marking, each wrong choice cancels a right one.
example_prompt: Which TWO are reasons the text gives for the library's new opening hours?

strong.answer: Chooses the two options stated in the text.
strong.why: Both choices are supported and nothing extra is chosen.

medium.answer: Chooses one correct option and one that sounds true but is not in the text.
medium.why: One right, one wrong: in our practice marking they cancel out.

weak.answer: Chooses four options to be safe.
weak.why: Extra wrong choices cancel right ones in our practice marking.

mistakes: Choosing options that are true in real life but not in the text.
